pokedexEntries.rb: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

pokedexEntries.ye: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in 7 colors.

pokedexEntries.go: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

pokedexEntries.si: Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geometric shape.

pokedexEntries.cr: It is said that it uses the seven-colored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.

pokedexEntries.ru: STARMIE’s center section - the core - glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this POKéMON has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”

pokedexEntries.sa: STARMIE swims through water by spinning its star-shaped body as if it were a propeller on a ship. The core at the center of this POKéMON’s body glows in seven colors.

pokedexEntries.fr: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

pokedexEntries.em: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.

pokedexEntries.dpp: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

pokedexEntries.hg: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

pokedexEntries.ss: Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geometric shape.

pokedexEntries.bw: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its core shines in many colors and sends radio signals into space to communicate with something.

pokedexEntries.x: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

pokedexEntries.y: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

pokedexEntries.or: Starmie’s center section—the core—glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”

pokedexEntries.as: Starmie swims through water by spinning its star-shaped body as if it were a propeller on a ship. The core at the center of this Pokémon’s body glows in seven colors.

pokedexEntries.su: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its unusual body shape, reminiscent of abstract art, led local people to spread rumors that this Pokémon may be an invader from outer space.

pokedexEntries.us: Its sparkling core is called “the gem of the sea.” This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

pokedexEntries.um: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

pokedexEntries.sh: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
